summary: To test a PR, clone ansible into a fresh directory, preferably on a VM since PR code may be unsafe, and fetch the PR into a local branch with git fetch origin refs/pull/XXXX/head; only PRs targeting devel are accepted.
questions: How do I check out someone's Ansible pull request locally?
Is it safe to test PR code on my laptop?

answer_card.title: Checking out a PR to test
answer_card.answer_md:
Test in a VM; PR code may contain mistakes or malicious code.
```shell-session
git clone https://github.com/ansible/ansible.git ansible-pr-testing
cd ansible-pr-testing
git fetch origin refs/pull/XXXX/head:testing_PRXXXX
git checkout testing_PRXXXX
```
Replace XXXX with the PR number. Only test PRs targeting `ansible:devel`; dot releases are cherry-picked by staff.
